programmes.d: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn’t what it seems.
Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple hasn’t seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.
Recent college grad Robert Terrible is out drinking at a club with friends celebrating. At 3 AM, he realizes he better call it a night and heads to the nearby garage where he parked his car.
It’s an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a shortcut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can’t believe his eyes.
It is 3 AM and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.
Carol Moleskie agrees to go on a hunting excursion with her husband, Bob. A few hours after they enter the woods, they emerge again, Bob frantically waving down traffic as he carries his bloody wife.
The four farmers and their remaining ladies go to a barn dance in Tallahassee, Florida.
The four farmers go on their final dates on the farms with the women they chose.
The guys swap the comforts of their farms for visits to the cities of their final ladies.
The farmers continue the home visits with their ladies; a farmer worries he made a mistake.
The farmers declare who have won their hearts; difficult goodbyes lead to heartfelt confessions.
The quest for true love begins in Alabama, where four new farmers begin their search for a soulmate.
When a man with a hand injury passes out from abdominal pain, tests lead to a shocking discovery.
A wrist fracture turns into a medical mystery. Two fishermen get stuck on the same lure.
The hospital is locked down when a nurse is shot in the ER. A bride is rushed in from her wedding.
A teenage football player suffers a stroke in the ER. A renowned doctor recounts his first major trauma.
A doctor with a severe bee allergy is stung while treating a critical patient who's been stabbed in the eye.
An apparent drive-by shooting victim is missing his nose.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Baby 911
programmes.d: In this TV special, parents bring in a young woman with stomach pain, but they don't know she is pregnant. A wife punches her husband unconscious then delivers her baby in the passenger seat of her car.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Back from the Dead
programmes.d: In this TV special, a woman wakes up after a doctor has declared her deceased. An ER doctor is fading in and out of consciousness but is able to diagnose his own condition. A doctor treats a young heart attack victim.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Celebration Stoppers
programmes.d: In this TV special, a bridesmaid nearly drinks herself to death, a middle-aged man suffers from septic shock after indulging oysters on his anniversary and a birthday boy is rushed to the ER.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Creepy Crawlies
programmes.d: In this TV special, a doctor with a phobia of insects is approached with a sequence of insect-related ailments. A doctor thinks his coughing patient has asthma until she mentions something moving in her rectum.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Didn't See It Coming
programmes.d: In this TV special, a man comes to the ER with a metal pipe stuck through his face and out his neck. A man lands on a shovel and it gets stuck in his perineum. Then, a heavy man has a knife lodged in his chest — only 1cm from his heart.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Labor Pains
programmes.d: In this TV special, a doctor delivers a baby in an elevator, another in a car and a third to parents who didn't even know they were expecting! A mother is near death after having a C-section and doctors are torn over treatment options.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Nurse in Charge
programmes.d: In this TV special, a handsome geriatric patient surrounded by his many girlfriends shocks everyone, including the nurses, when he goes into life-threatening painkiller withdrawal.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Nursing Intuition
programmes.d: In this TV special, a stroke patient's heart mysteriously stops, starts again and then stops. A nurse is in a predicament when the only available bed for a foul-mouthed woman is next to an elderly nun awaiting hip surgery.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Party Fails
programmes.d: In this TV special, a group of frat boys arrives at the ER due to a blue pee epidemic and a bride with kidney stones refuses to remove her wedding gown.
It’s a late night and a Vietnam veteran with a history of mental illness is drunk and stumbling through an apartment complex. When the police arrive, he pulls a gun and shoots himself in the head.
